title: Coding Agents coordination output
description: The complete parent-owned result of an explicitly activated Coding Agents objective. Incomplete, blocked, or unavailable execution is represented by the broker's error or stop envelope instead of this success output.

summary.description: The completed user-visible coding outcome owned and integrated by the parent Codex task.

changedPaths.description: Source or deliverable paths changed for this objective; empty only when the completed objective was non-mutating.

acceptanceEvidence.description: The one task-sized semantic acceptance bundle actually executed, or an empty list when the completed objective required no executable check.

externalEffects.description: Separately authorized commit, refresh, activation, publication, or other external-effect outcomes; empty when none occurred.

unresolvedRisks.description: Concrete remaining unverified risks after completion; empty when none are known.

continuityState.description: Whether optional untracked Coding Agents continuity state was needed for this completed objective.
